briefs.summary: Donald Trump made a notable return to the White House Correspondents' Dinner, three months after surviving a shooting incident. This event is drawing significant attention as it highlights Trump's contentious relationship with the media, especially following a violent episode that many thought might alter his public engagements. briefs.title: Jantar Mantar protest LIVE: Need 'yes or no answer' on Pradhan's resignation, says CJP ahead of talks with Govt. today
briefs.summary: Protests are intensifying at Jantar Mantar as the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) prepare for renewed talks with the Indian government. Ahead of these discussions, the CJP has demanded a straightforward "yes or no" answer regarding the resignation of Union Minister Pradhan, signaling the urgency of their demands. Security measures have been heightened, with barricades installed to manage the growing number of demonstrators. This situation follows a recent fast by activist Wangchuk, which has drawn further attention to the protests. As tensions rise, both sides are gearing up for what could be a pivotal moment in the ongoing dialogue between the government and protestors.

briefs.title: Jana Nayagan
briefs.summary: The release of "Jana Nayagan," featuring the popular actor Thalapathy Vijay, has sparked significant attention due to its mixed reviews and box office performance. Critics have described the film as an "awful epic" that overwhelms viewers with AI-generated imagery, raising questions about its artistic direction. Despite a strong opening that garnered Rs 112 crore, the film experienced a sharp 50% drop in box office collections on its second day, indicating a potential waning interest among audiences. The film's ending has also left viewers puzzled, with many expressing confusion over the final scenes involving Vijay and co-star Bobby Deol. As Vijay's last film, the combination of its ambitious visuals and disappointing narrative has made "Jana Nayagan" a hot topic of discussion among fans and critics alike.

briefs.title: Centre lying about pellet gun use against protesters, says Rahul Gandhi
briefs.summary: Rahul Gandhi has accused the Indian government of lying about its use of pellet guns against protesters, particularly in the context of recent demonstrations by students. During a press conference, he presented a victim who suffered severe eye damage from a pellet gun, emphasizing the need for accountability and transparency from authorities. Gandhi's statements come amid rising tensions over police tactics used during protests, with calls for the government to cease such measures. The issue has gained traction on social media, as videos of the victim and Gandhi's impassioned appeals resonate with the public. This controversy highlights ongoing concerns regarding police brutality and the treatment of dissent in India.

briefs.title: Trump orders Smithsonian to post warnings about 'inaccurate' US history
briefs.summary: President Trump has directed the Smithsonian’s National Museum of American History to install signs warning visitors that its portrayal of U.S. history is “inaccurate,” marking a significant escalation in his ongoing conflict with the institution. This order reflects Trump's broader critique of how American history is presented in museums and educational settings, which he claims misrepresents key events and figures. The move has sparked widespread discussions about historical interpretation and the role of museums in shaping public understanding of the past. As the debate intensifies, it highlights the increasing polarization surrounding narratives of American history and the influence of political perspectives on cultural institutions.

briefs.title: 'Thank You Friends': PM Modi's Reel Tops 303 Million Views Amid CJP Protest
briefs.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Instagram reel, titled "Thank You Friends," has garnered over 303 million views, setting a world record for social media engagement. The reel features Modi expressing gratitude to youth for their suggestions on addressing the recent paper leak controversies, particularly in relation to the NEET examination. This surge in views coincides with ongoing protests by the Central Joint Committee (CJP) against the government's handling of these leaks, highlighting a significant public discourse on educational integrity. Modi's outreach appears to be an attempt to connect with younger voters and address their concerns directly, while also attempting to shift the narrative amid the protests. The juxtaposition of the reel's popularity against the backdrop of these protests underscores a complex political landscape in India.

briefs.title: Indian activist Wangchuk ends 26-day hunger strike as 'Cockroach' protesters vow to press on
briefs.summary: Indian activist Sonam Wangchuk has concluded a 26-day hunger strike aimed at drawing attention to pressing issues faced by the youth in India, particularly in the context of environmental and educational reforms. His protest coincided with ongoing demonstrations by a group known as the "Cockroach" protesters, who are determined to continue their activism despite Wangchuk's decision to end his strike. The protests, which have garnered significant media attention, are taking place at Jantar Mantar, where representatives from the Coalition for Justice and Peace (CJP) have engaged in discussions with government officials, though a resolution remains elusive. This situation highlights a broader youth movement in India that is increasingly vocal about their demands for change and accountability from the government.

briefs.title: Piyush Goyal files police complaint over AI Deepfake video, says misinformation bid 'will not be...
briefs.summary: Piyush Goyal, India's Minister of Commerce and Industry, has filed a police complaint regarding an AI-generated deepfake video that misrepresents his remarks, which he claims is part of a misinformation campaign. The video, which has been linked to "Pakistani propaganda accounts," has prompted the Press Information Bureau (PIB) to issue a fact-check confirming its inauthenticity. Goyal emphasized that such attempts to spread false information will not be tolerated, highlighting the growing concern over the use of deepfake technology in political discourse. The incident has sparked discussions about the implications of AI in media and the need for robust measures to combat misinformation. An FIR has been registered as authorities investigate the matter further.
